$schema.description: JSON Schema URL used by editors for validation and completion.

enabled.description: Enable this package's tools, provider shim, compaction hooks, and commands.

glyphStyle.description: Glyph style used by the extension UI.

autoEnable.description: Automatically activate enabled package tools on supported models.

nativeProviderTools.description: Deprecated compatibility override. Move per-model hosted tool behavior to extension models.json.

openaiTransport.description: Deprecated compatibility override. Move per-model Responses transport to extension models.json.

openaiWebSocketPrewarm.description: Deprecated compatibility override. Move per-model one-shot session-startup WebSocket prewarm behavior to extension models.json.

fastMode.description: Global user toggle for the Fast service tier declared by the active model profile.

compactionMode.description: Deprecated compatibility override. Move per-model compaction behavior to extension models.json.

requestProfile.description: Deprecated compatibility override. Move Responses mode, reasoning summary, prompt placement, patch transport, and tool capabilities to extension models.json.

responsesMode.description: Responses protocol mode. Lite requires an endpoint that implements the Codex Responses Lite contract.

reasoningSummary.description: Deprecated compatibility override for the reasoning summary mode. Move this to responses.reasoningSummary in the per-model catalog.

systemPromptPlacement.description: Where Standard Responses places Pi's system prompt. Responses Lite always uses a developer message.

patchTransport.description: Transport for apply_patch: a JSON function tool or the Codex freeform custom tool.

supportsHostedTools.description: Enable hosted-tool activation and request rewriting. Responses Lite always disables hosted tools.

supportsParallelTools.description: Enable parallel tool calls in provider requests. Responses Lite always disables parallel tools.

apiKeyMode.description: Deprecated compatibility override. Move the endpoint/auth shape to responses.endpoint in extension models.json.

imageGeneration.description: Deprecated compatibility override. Move per-model image-generation support to extension models.json.

webSearchEnabled.description: Deprecated compatibility override. Move per-model web-search support to extension models.json.

imageOutputDir.description: Directory for generated images. Relative paths resolve against the workspace root.

imageModel.description: Image model used by standalone generation, hosted image tool rewriting, and direct fallback.

directImageApiFallback.description: Allow direct OpenAI Images API generation when native Codex generation is unavailable.

viewImage.description: Deprecated compatibility override. Move per-model view_image support to extension models.json.

viewImageWorkspaceOnly.description: Reject view_image paths outside the active workspace.

applyPatchEnabled.description: Deprecated compatibility override. Move per-model apply_patch support to extension models.json.

additionalModelIds.description: Deprecated compatibility allowlist. Add exact per-model entries to extension models.json instead.

deferApplyPatchRendering.description: Use Pi's fallback tool renderer instead of the built-in streaming filesystem preview.
